jobs.title: PILOT Predictive Integrity Link Optimization and Telemetry platform
jobs.description: PILOT Next-generation data center interconnects need next-generation diagnostic and analytic capabilities. Meet PILOT. Intelligent connectivity PILOT is a powerful platform that combines advanced telemetry with system-level debug tools to bring intelligent connectivity to network designers and administrators. One environment, many features Enables rapid system bring-up, deep visibility into link behavior, and predictive insight into signal integrity issues—before they become system-level failures. Built for AI Today, PILOT gives system designers the tools they need to confidently scale PCIe and ZeroFlap deployments in complex, high-density AI and cloud environments. AI built in In conjunction with our customers’ telemetry systems, AI-powered analytics forecast potential failures, enabling preemptive intervention during maintenance windows to reduce system downtime. jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Accelerating GPU-to-GPU communications in clusters
jobs.description: AI infrastructure Networking is the “new compute” in the AI data center. Our high-speed connectivity solutions are core to this transformation. AECs AI training requires massive GPU clusters and demanding backend infrastructure. Credo’s AECs provide the reliability and scalability to connect server racks and accelerator clusters. Optical solutions In AI compute clusters, multiple servers comprised of tightly coupled GPUs must function as one GPU to prevent performance bottlenecks. Credo optical products are essential to GPU-to-GPU communications. PCIe retimers Retimers enable PCIe signals to travel beyond a single server enclosure, supporting rack-scale deployments. Credo PCIe retimer solutions offer a low-latency, high-throughput open solution well-suited for scale-up networks. Ethernet retimers AI scale-out architectures require connectivity between compute nodes, storage, applications, and other networked resources. Credo’s widely deployed Ethernet retimers enable data to transmit seamlessly in these complex environments. jobs.description: Cloud & hyperscalers Our technology connects the infrastructure of some of the largest, most complex cloud and hyperscale data centers Ethernet retimers Disaggregated architecture in hyperscale data centers can mean longer distances between resources. Credo retimers extend high-speed signal integrity across racks and complex topologies. PCIe retimers Cloud services must accommodate fluctuating demand—from seasonal spikes to viral app usage. Credo PCIe retimers allow cloud providers to build modular systems that scale up and scale out. AECs Cloud services need to operate 24/7/365, often providing mission-critical applications. Credo AECs provide plug-and-play connectivity designed for lossless operation and reliability. Optical DSPs Hyperscale data centers are under pressure to reduce energy usage. With a focus on minimizing energy consumption, Credo optical DSPs include features such as programmable power-saving modes.
